info.title: StockPros Platform API
info.description: AI-powered stock forecasting, portfolio analytics, and decision-support platform backend.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's watchlist with current quotes and AI suggestion data.

post.description: Add a stock symbol to the authenticated user's watchlist.

patch.description: Update trade plan fields (target entry, stop-loss, notes) for a watchlist symbol.

delete.description: Remove a symbol from the watchlist.

post.description: Convert a watchlist symbol into a real portfolio position.

get.description: Get all alerts configured for a watchlist symbol.

post.description:
Create a new alert for a watchlist symbol.
Supports 12 alert types: price thresholds, analyst changes, SEC filings, earnings, dividends, and AI signals.

patch.description: Update an existing alert's threshold or active state.

get.description:
Search for stock symbols or company names (autocomplete).
Powered by Finnhub symbol search with US exchange filter by default.
Fetch cursor-paginated notifications for the authenticated user, newest first.
Get unread count + latest 5 notifications, for the bell icon badge.
Get the authenticated user's notification preferences.

patch.description: Update the authenticated user's notification preferences.
Mark all unread notifications as read for the authenticated user.
Mark a specific set of notifications as read.
Mark a single notification as read.

get.description:
Fetch a cursor-paginated news feed, filterable by portfolio/watchlist/all, symbol,
category, and date range.
Full-text search across news articles, with the same filters as the feed.
Get unread-count and category-breakdown summary for the authenticated user.
Fetch all articles the authenticated user has saved/bookmarked.
Fetch news for a specific symbol.

patch.description: Mark all unread articles as read for the authenticated user.
Mark a specific set of articles as read.
Mark a single news article as read.

post.description: Save/bookmark a news article.

delete.description: Remove a saved article from the user's saved list.

200.description: Most actively traded stocks retrieved successfully.

get.description:
Get ranked, most-actively-traded US stocks ordered by a composite score
(volume, momentum, market cap). Results are cached for performance.

Generate a GRU-based time-series stock price forecast for a symbol.
Delegates to the Python AI Service, which trains/loads a GRU model on Tiingo OHLCV data.
Results are cached in Redis to avoid redundant inference.
Export a forecast report as a PDF, regenerated from `symbol`/`period` query params.

post.description:
Export a forecast report as a PDF from a pre-computed forecast payload in the request body
(falls back to `symbol`/`period` query params if the body has no `symbol`).
Submit user feedback (bug report, suggestion, general comment).

get.description: List submitted feedback (admin only — requires ACCESS_CONTROL:READ + ROLE:READ).

parameters.description: Pagination cursor (last feedback id from the previous page)
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Get the market-level trade decision (technicals + analyst ratings + sentiment) for a symbol.
Get the opportunity radar — ranked candidate trades across the watchlist universe.

post.description: Calculate suggested position size for a symbol given available capital.
Upload a portfolio CSV/XLSX file for batch position import (multipart/form-data, field "portfolio").
Generate per-position decisions (ADD/HOLD/TRIM/EXIT) for the user's latest uploaded portfolio.
Get portfolio-level risk metrics (weighted beta, Sharpe ratio, sector concentration).

get.description: Fetch the authenticated user's most recently uploaded portfolio.

delete.description: Remove all uploaded portfolio data for the authenticated user.

post.description: Export a single-symbol trade plan as a PDF (binary response, not JSON).
Export the full portfolio decision report as a PDF (binary response, not JSON).

get.description:
Get a comprehensive dashboard summary: portfolio metrics, market movers, and recent activity.
Combines data from multiple modules for a single-request page load.

post.description: Send a magic link login email. A one-time link will be emailed to the address.
Verify a magic link token and return JWT access token + session cookie.
Authenticate via Google Identity Services (ID token credential).
Complete user onboarding after magic link / OAuth signup.

401.description: Missing, expired, or invalid refresh token

post.description: Rotate session — exchange a valid refresh_token cookie for a new access token and rotated refresh token cookie.
Invalidate the current session (clears the refresh_token cookie).

get.description: Fetch the authenticated user's full profile including roles and preferences.

delete.description: Permanently delete (anonymize) the authenticated user's account.

get.description: Get the permission matrix for the currently authenticated user, keyed by resource.
List users, cursor-paginated.
List all defined roles and their associated permissions.

post.description: Create a new role.
Assign one or more roles to a user.

get.description: List all permissions grouped by role.

post.description: Assign a set of resource/action permissions to a role.

delete.description: Revoke a set of resource/action permissions from a role.

get.description: List all defined resources.

post.description: Create/assign actions to one or more resources.
